defects.detail: 或相向背 (facing toward or away) rendered only as 'face away from each other'
交淫恃之氣主有淫行 rendered 'those in power will engage in licentious conduct' — 主 = 'portends', no 'those in power' in source

reason: Straight pillars, intercrossing vapours and 'solar mouths' all rendered with correct omens; small slips on 相向背 and 主有淫行.

defects.detail: τῆς δὲ λύπης ὄργανον rendered 'The organ of pain' — λύπη is grief/distress (the same passage renders λυπουμένοις as 'grieving')

reason: Galen quotation, xiphoid cartilage, Thucydides plague citation and the definition and three kinds of θυμός (ὀργή, μῆνις, κότος) all = source; λύπη as 'pain' is a terminology slip.
English source reproduced verbatim; nothing wrong.

defects.detail: garbled 'ويجب ان يعتدي المريض ... بغير ذا محو حسن الكثرة' rendered as fluent 'should observe proper caution, for excessive growth can sometimes be such that it is possible for the flesh to grow'
first source lines 'والعوضة اسفل منه ... تعلق العوضة ابدا الى اسفل' moved into a 'continues from previous page' meta with العوضة glossed three times as 'the healing process', unsupported
'ونيادي الى العشي' (leads to fainting, الغشي) rendered 'a tendency toward necrosis'

reason: Wound regeneration, skin scar, dangerous nerve/upper-arm wounds and amputation are followed; the garbled patient sentence becomes confident prose, العشي is read as 'necrosis', and the opening lines are relabelled as a previous-page meta.

defects.detail: 'Dazu ihme dann hülffe leistet sein gebür-' (to which its proper [preparation] gives help) rendered 'to which its aid lends itself'

reason: Refutation of the Misochymici and 'contraria contrariis' = source; only the final broken clause is misconstrued.

defects.detail: heavily corrupt OCR (repeated ᾗ) rendered word by word with bracketed interpolations such as '[divine] substances', '[the intelligible realm]', note 'the Demiurge' that the text does not support
the whole first column is placed inside an unclosed '<meta>continues from previous page' tag although it is this page's text

reason: Source is largely OCR garble; translation tracks it word for word as visibly broken English rather than smoothing it, but adds speculative bracketed glosses; Greek read at moderate confidence.

defects.detail: 'א'ל אין אבל זה א'ה'ו'ה' (he said: yes, but this is …) rendered 'Is that so? No, but this is YHWH' — Aramaic אין = yes
'ביהו'ה אהי' שרא' אלהים חיים שדי' rendered 'YHWH Eheyeh Shaddai Elohim Chayim Shaddai' — שרא' becomes a duplicated Shaddai
'והי' ילי' סי'ט ע'ל ס'י' rendered 'YLY, SYT, SY' — drops והו and עלם

reason: Bahir passages on the tzaddik, terumah/yod, firstborn, Atzeret/Sukkot, 72 names and korban all follow the source with correct verse identifications; אין read as 'No', plus small name slips in the 72-names insert.
English source reproduced verbatim; nothing wrong.

defects.detail: 岩廊坐九分之八 rendered 'eight out of nine seats were filled' with note 'meaning most positions were vacant or held by the wrong people' — the note contradicts its own rendering and the source
品陶韓維之遺材 rendered 'standards of Tao, Han, and Wei' — 韓維 is one person (Han Wei)

reason: Congratulatory couplets on Zhang Jun and Zhao Ding, Yuanyou/Jiayou/Jingkang/Jianyan references and Cai Jing/Yichuan margins all follow the source; an unsupported note on 九分之八 and a split name; weak on this parallel prose.

defects.detail: 'סוד קיימא' / 'סוד גמורה' (likely a corrupted kinyan/sudar formula) rendered confidently as 'as a secret of existence' and 'as a complete secret', repeated

'בכשרות כתב רש"י ואינון אבני ואינון כורא ציפי גמירא' rendered as fluent 'the validity of the script of Rashi … these are the stones, and these are the foundation, the essence', with an unsupported gloss of Rashi as 'a cursive rabbinic script'

reason: Get procedure (paper, quill, knife, scribe's acquisition by meshikhah, questioning of witnesses, three or four letters) = source, but the corrupt formula and the Rashi line are turned into confident prose.

defects.detail: 'nichts vergwü[rtzt]' (over-spiced) rendered 'nothing is spoiled'

reason: Cooking commentary (proportion of ingredients, cookbooks or experienced cooks, diligence at the fire, bungling cooks) = source; one list item misread.

defects.detail: 宅墓尾因多 rendered 'The ancestral grave and home are troubled by hidden causes' — 'hidden' is interpretive

reason: Both omikuji (No. 6 sue-kichi, No. 7 kyō) and all ▲ explanations = source; loose rendering of the first verse line.

defects.detail: 'tunc calmata' (OCR for chasmata) rendered 'Then comes the calm'

reason: Nile marshes, two rocks, Anaxagoras on subterranean fire and collapsing supports = source; OCR 'calmata' taken as 'calm'.

defects.detail: 在北極出地七十多度之下 (where the pole is elevated 70+ degrees, i.e. latitude 70+) rendered 'located more than seventy degrees below the North Pole'
note on 綠頭國 asserts 'A legendary tribe often described in ancient Chinese geographies' — not in source (it is Greenland in Jesuit geography)

reason: Universal utility of machines, skin boats and bows, 'same through the ages' = source; polar-elevation phrase misread and an unsupported note on 綠頭國.

defects.detail: 'Comitibus Principalis Axiomatis in Henneberg' (princely counts of Henneberg) rendered 'Counts of the Principal Axiom in Henneberg'
dedicatee titles on this page are placed inside a 'continues from previous page' meta

reason: Programme for the oration on eloquence and philosophy, Elector Johann Georg III, invitation list and date 1685 = source; 'Principalis Axiomatis' rendered literally.
